claim_ceiling: This does not establish arbitrary new request-target vocabulary construction. The tested target atoms are still exact current tokens from an endogenous externally-qualified opaque projection. It establishes that once such bound target atoms exist, existing lived-history/program owners can construct multi-step request programs without caller-supplied sequence identity, semantic labels, or execution authority.
observed: Two independently built fixtures used different opaque request-base IDs, different projection candidate digests, different target tokens, and different bound-specialization IDs/signatures.
Each fixture reconstructed the same abstract [0,1,0] three-step request program from recurrent organism-owned history without receiving a program sequence or preferred target at generation time.
Generated candidates carried truth/execution authority NONE and added zero action intents/executions; bound request handlers were never called during construction.
Projection drift staled the bound request atoms and removed the prior program from the current generator surface.
